nodes.tagline: We give AI agents realtime web context.
nodes.description:
Context.dev gives AI agents structured data from any website through a single API.

We help developers build smarter agents & products that depend on accurate, fresh web data.

If you need structured data from the internet, you need Context.dev

Proud to power agentic products at Mintlify, Super, Vizzy, Klarna, and 280 other companies.

biggestContribution.title: Parker Conrad X reply to Context.dev founder Yahia Bakour
biggestContribution.text: Parker Conrad replied to @mynameisyahia, the official X handle for Context.dev founder Yahia Bakour in the YC Summer 2026 snapshot. Native reply text: @ryanstellar @mynameisyahia This is just dead wrong. I did YC twice in that timeframe and like the ONLY thing they tell you to do, over and over again, was go talk to users, customers, prospects and in person is better. It was repeated so often that it was exhausting.
